cloud_account_ids.description: When non-empty, only renewal events for these cloud accounts are returned

start_date.description: Start of filter range (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 30 days before today (UTC) when omitted.

end_date.description: End of filter range (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today (UTC) when omitted.

regions.description: When non-empty, only events whose region matches one of these values

service.description: AWS service type; defaults to Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud - Compute when omitted
